remarks: Freshly painted and move-in ready, this spacious 4-bed, 2-bath South Norwalk home offers exceptional flexibility and convenience. The bright interior features two bedrooms on the main level and two upstairs-ideal for work-from-home, guests, or multi-level living. The full interior repaint gives the home a clean, modern feel throughout.  A standout feature of this location is the free neighborhood waterfront park at the end of the street, offering direct access to Long Island Sound for kayaking, paddleboarding, and enjoying the coastal lifestyle.  Close to the SONO train station, marinas, restaurants, waterfront, shopping, parks, and beaches. Driveway parking and easy access to commuting routes complete the package.  A rare 4-bedroom rental opportunity in South Norwalk. Available immediately.
